---- MODULE W4Od13m8p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Clients, Machines, Cap, MaxMsgs

VARIABLES coarse, fine, stock, pending, delivered

None == "none"
vars == <<coarse, fine, stock, pending, delivered>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in Clients \cup {None}
  /\ fine \in [Machines -> Clients \cup {None}]
  /\ stock \in [Machines -> 0..Cap]
  /\ pending \subseteq [mc: Machines, amt: 1..Cap, id: 1..MaxMsgs]
  /\ delivered \subseteq 1..MaxMsgs

Init ==
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ fine = [m \in Machines |-> None]
  /\ stock = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ delivered = {}

AcquireCoarse(c) ==
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ coarse' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, stock, pending, delivered>>

AcquireFine(c, m) ==
  /\ coarse = c
  /\ fine[m] = None
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![m] = c]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, stock, pending, delivered>>

SendRestock(m, a, i) ==
  /\ i \notin delivered
  /\ \A r \in pending: r.id # i
  /\ Cardinality(pending) < MaxMsgs
  /\ pending' = pending \cup {[mc |-> m, amt |-> a, id |-> i]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, stock, delivered>>

ApplyRestock(c, r) ==
  /\ r \in pending
  /\ fine[r.mc] = c
  /\ stock[r.mc] + r.amt <= Cap
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![r.mc] = @ + r.amt]
  /\ pending' = pending \ {r}
  /\ delivered' = delivered \cup {r.id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

Dispense(m) ==
  /\ fine[m] # None
  /\ stock[m] > 0
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![m] = @ - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, pending, delivered>>

Release(c) ==
  /\ coarse = c
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ fine' = [m \in Machines |-> IF fine[m] = c THEN None ELSE fine[m]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stock, pending, delivered>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Clients: AcquireCoarse(c)
  \/ \E c \in Clients, m \in Machines: AcquireFine(c, m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines, a \in 1..Cap, i \in 1..MaxMsgs: SendRestock(m, a, i)
  \/ \E c \in Clients, r \in pending: ApplyRestock(c, r)
  \/ \E m \in Machines: Dispense(m)
  \/ \E c \in Clients: Release(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

BoundedCapacity == \A m \in Machines: stock[m] <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Clients = {c1, c2}
    Machines = {m1, m2}
    Cap = 3
    MaxMsgs = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl: A network of vending machines shares a restock supply chain. To restock or service a machine an operator must acquire locks hierarchically: first a single coarse network-wide lock, then a fine per-machine lock. Restock messages travel over an unreliable channel and can be reordered, so pending restock requests form an unordered set tagged with message ids. The operations are: AcquireCoarse (an operator takes the single coarse lock when it is free), AcquireFine (an operator already holding the coarse lock takes the fine lock on one specific machine), SendRestock (a restock request for some amount for some machine is enqueued into the pending set with a fresh id, up to a bounded number of in-flight messages), ApplyRestock (an operator holding a machine's fine lock applies any one pending restock message for that machine, adding its amount to that machine's stock only when the machine's fixed capacity would not be exceeded, then marks that message delivered so it cannot be reused), Dispense (a machine whose fine lock is held dispenses one item, decrementing its stock), and Release (an operator drops the coarse lock together with every fine lock it holds). Each machine has a fixed capacity. SAFETY PROPERTY: no vending machine ever holds more items than its fixed capacity.

VARIABLES coarse, fine, stage, crashed, sealLog

None == "none"
vars == <<coarse, fine, stage, crashed, sealLog>>
Stages == {"queued", "washing", "final", "done"}

Range(s) == {s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s}

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in Operators \cup {None}
  /\ fine \in [Cars -> Operators \cup {None}]
  /\ stage \in [Cars -> Stages]
  /\ crashed \subseteq Operators
  /\ sealLog \in Seq(Cars)

Init ==
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ fine = [k \in Cars |-> None]
  /\ stage = [k \in Cars |-> "queued"]
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ sealLog = << >>

AcquireLine(o) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ coarse = None
  /\ coarse' = o
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, stage, crashed, sealLog>>

AcquireBay(o, k) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ coarse = o
  /\ fine[k] = None
  /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![k] = o]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, stage, crashed, sealLog>>

Advance(o, k) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ fine[k] = o
  /\ stage[k] \in {"queued", "washing"}
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![k] = IF stage[k] = "queued" THEN "washing" ELSE "final"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed, sealLog>>

Seal(o, k) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ fine[k] = o
  /\ stage[k] = "final"
  /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![k] = "done"]
  /\ sealLog' = Append(sealLog, k)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, crashed>>

Crash(o) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {o}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, stage, sealLog>>

Recover(o) ==
  /\ o \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {o}
  /\ coarse' = IF coarse = o THEN None ELSE coarse
  /\ fine' = [k \in Cars |-> IF fine[k] = o THEN None ELSE fine[k]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, sealLog>>

Release(o) ==
  /\ o \notin crashed
  /\ coarse = o
  /\ coarse' = None
  /\ fine' = [k \in Cars |-> IF fine[k] = o THEN None ELSE fine[k]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<stage, crashed, sealLog>>

Next ==
  \/ \E o \in Operators: AcquireLine(o)
  \/ \E o \in Operators, k \in Cars: AcquireBay(o, k)
  \/ \E o \in Operators, k \in Cars: Advance(o, k)
  \/ \E o \in Operators, k \in Cars: Seal(o, k)
  \/ \E o \in Operators: Crash(o)
  \/ \E o \in Operators: Recover(o)
  \/ \E o \in Operators: Release(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SealOnlyOnce == Cardinality(Range(sealLog)) = Len(sealLog)
====
nl: A car-wash conveyor line processes cars through wash stages. The whole conveyor is guarded by a coarse line lock; each car's wash bay is guarded by a fine per-car lock, and an operator must hold the coarse lock before it can take a fine lock (hierarchical locking, coarse then fine). Any operator may crash silently: after crashing it stops acting and still holds whatever locks it had, until a watchdog eventually recovers it. The operations are: AcquireLine (a non-crashed operator takes the single coarse line lock when it is free), AcquireBay (a non-crashed operator holding the coarse lock takes the fine lock on one car's bay), Advance (a non-crashed operator holding a car's bay lock moves that car forward one wash stage, queued to washing to final), Seal (a non-crashed operator holding a car's bay lock applies the final protective seal to a car that has reached the final stage, marking the car done and recording the seal event in an append-only seal log), Crash (any not-yet-crashed operator crashes silently while keeping any locks it held), Recover (a watchdog restarts a crashed operator, clearing its crashed status and releasing every coarse or fine lock it was holding), and Release (a non-crashed operator voluntarily drops the coarse lock together with every fine lock it holds). Sealing is irreversible: once a car is sealed it is done and leaves the line. SAFETY PROPERTY: the seal log never records the same car more than once, so the irreversible seal is applied to each car at most once.

InflightIds == {u.id : u \in inflight}

  /\ inflight \subseteq [id: Ids, val: Vals]
  /\ Cardinality(inflight) <= 1
  /\ record \in Nat
  /\ appliedIds \subseteq Ids

  /\ crashed \subseteq Robots

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ inflight = {}
  /\ record = 0
  /\ appliedIds = {}
  /\ submitted = {}
  /\ crashed = {}

Submit(r, id, val) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ id \notin submitted
  /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, [id |-> id, val |-> val])
  /\ submitted' = submitted \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, record, appliedIds, crashed>>

Dequeue ==
  /\ inflight = {}
  /\ queue # << >>
  /\ inflight' = {Head(queue)}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, appliedIds, submitted, crashed>>

Commit ==
  /\ inflight # {}
  /\ \E u \in inflight:
       /\ record' = record + u.val
       /\ appliedIds' = appliedIds \cup {u.id}
  /\ inflight' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, submitted, crashed>>

Crash(r) ==
  /\ r \notin crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inflight, record, appliedIds, submitted>>

Recover(r) ==
  /\ r \in crashed
  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {r}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, inflight, record, appliedIds, submitted>>

  \/ \E r \in Robots, id \in Ids, val \in Vals: Submit(r, id, val)
  \/ Dequeue
  \/ Commit
  \/ \E r \in Robots: Crash(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots: Recover(r)

NoLostUpdates == submitted = appliedIds \cup QueuedIds \cup InflightIds
====
nl: A fleet of warehouse robots submits updates to a shared inventory record through a bounded work queue with backpressure. Each update carries a unique id and a value. The work queue has a fixed maximum length; when it is full, new submissions are refused (backpressure). A single processing slot pulls one queued update at a time and later commits it to the shared record. Any robot may crash silently and stop submitting until it recovers; queued and in-flight updates are durable and survive a robot crash. The operations are: Submit (a non-crashed robot enqueues a fresh update id and value at the tail of the work queue, but only while the queue is below its maximum length), Dequeue (when the processing slot is empty and the queue is non-empty, the head update is moved out of the queue into the single processing slot), Commit (the update in the processing slot is applied to the shared record, its value added to the record and its id recorded as applied, then the slot is emptied), Crash (a not-yet-crashed robot crashes silently), and Recover (a crashed robot restarts). SAFETY PROPERTY: every submitted update is always accounted for as either already applied to the record, still waiting in the work queue, or in the processing slot, so no submitted update is ever lost.

INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl: A stock exchange runs its opening auction across a ring of member nodes. A single token circulates around the ring, and only the node currently holding the token may enter the critical section that writes orders into the shared auction book (the matching engine is the exclusive critical resource). Nodes are numbered in a ring; the token is passed to the next node in ring order. Any node may crash silently and stop participating until it recovers, keeping the token if it held it. The operations are: Enter (the node currently holding the token, if it is not crashed and not already inside, enters the critical section), Work (a node inside the critical section, while not crashed, submits one order into the shared auction book, up to a fixed book capacity), Exit (a node inside the critical section, while not crashed, leaves the critical section), PassToken (the token holder, if not crashed and not inside the critical section, passes the token to the next node in the ring), Crash (a not-yet-crashed node crashes silently, retaining the token if it held it), and Recover (a crashed node restarts). SAFETY PROPERTY: a node is inside the critical section only while it holds the single circulating token, so at most one node ever occupies the critical section at a time.

---- MODULE W4Od7m2p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Participants, Total, MaxAmt

VARIABLES holdings, escrow, phase, proposal, votes

vars == <<holdings, escrow, phase, proposal, votes>>
anchor == CHOOSE p \in Participants : TRUE

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN holdings[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
  /\ holdings \in [Participants -> 0..Total]
  /\ escrow \in 0..Total
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}
  /\ proposal \in [src: Participants, dst: Participants, amt: 1..MaxAmt]
  /\ votes \subseteq [p: Participants, yes: BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ holdings = [p \in Participants |-> IF p = anchor THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ escrow = 0
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ proposal = [src |-> anchor, dst |-> anchor, amt |-> 1]
  /\ votes = {}

Propose(s, d, a) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ s # d
  /\ holdings[s] >= a
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ proposal' = [src |-> s, dst |-> d, amt |-> a]
  /\ holdings' = [holdings EXCEPT ![s] = @ - a]
  /\ escrow' = escrow + a
  /\ votes' = {}

Vote(p, b) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A v \in votes : v.p # p
  /\ votes' = votes \cup {[p |-> p, yes |-> b]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holdings, escrow, phase, proposal>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \A p \in Participants : \E v \in votes : v.p = p /\ v.yes = TRUE
  /\ holdings' = [holdings EXCEPT ![proposal.dst] = @ + escrow]
  /\ escrow' = 0
  /\ phase' = "committed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes>>

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ \E v \in votes : v.yes = FALSE
  /\ holdings' = [holdings EXCEPT ![proposal.src] = @ + escrow]
  /\ escrow' = 0
  /\ phase' = "aborted"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes>>

Reset ==
  /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ votes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holdings, escrow, proposal>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Participants, d \in Participants, a \in 1..MaxAmt: Propose(s, d, a)
  \/ \E p \in Participants, b \in BOOLEAN: Vote(p, b)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CONSTANTS
    Participants = {p1, p2}
    Total = 2
    MaxAmt = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conservation
nl: A container-ship crane yard moves containers between participant holding areas using two-phase commit so that a transfer either fully happens or is fully rolled back. There is one active transaction at a time, coordinated in two phases: a proposal reserves containers from a source, participants then vote, and finally the transaction commits or aborts. Vote messages arrive over a channel that can reorder them, so votes are collected into an unordered set keyed by participant. The total number of containers in the yard is fixed. The operations are: Propose (when idle, a transaction is opened to move a positive amount from a source holding area that has enough containers to a distinct destination; the amount is immediately removed from the source and held in escrow while voting proceeds), Vote (during voting, a participant that has not yet voted casts a yes or no vote into the vote set), Commit (during voting, once every participant has cast a yes vote, the escrowed containers are delivered to the destination and the transaction is marked committed), Abort (during voting, if any participant voted no, the escrowed containers are returned to the source and the transaction is marked aborted), and Reset (a committed or aborted transaction is cleared back to idle). SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of containers held across all participants plus those currently in escrow is always exactly the fixed yard total, so containers are never created or destroyed.

nl: A wildfire surveillance drone swarm coordinates through leader election with failover. A global epoch number identifies the current leadership term; each election bumps the epoch and installs a new leader, and each drone caches its own believed epoch. Only the current leader, holding the current epoch, is authorized to issue sector assignments; a drone whose cached epoch is behind the global epoch is stale and must not act. Any drone may crash silently and stop participating until it recovers. Tracking resets the set of drones that have acted whenever a new leadership term begins. The operations are: Elect (a non-crashed drone becomes the new leader, bumping the global epoch, setting its own cached epoch to the new term, and clearing the record of who has acted this term), Assign (the current leader, if not crashed and not stale, issues a sector assignment and is recorded as having acted this term), Sync (a non-crashed drone whose cached epoch is behind catches up to the current global epoch), Crash (a not-yet-crashed drone crashes silently), and Recover (a crashed drone restarts). SAFETY PROPERTY: in every leadership term the only drone that ever issues an action is the current authorized leader, so no unauthorized or stale drone ever acts.

  /\ votes \subseteq Controllers

  /\ ~Allocated(proposal.slot)

  /\ phase' = "idle"

  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, votes, allocs, crashed>>

  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, proposal, votes, allocs>>

  /\ crashed' = crashed \ {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, proposal, votes, allocs>>

nl: A smart-home door lock network grants timed access slots by quorum voting among its controllers. Each allocation of an access slot to a requester must be approved by a quorum (a majority) of controllers before it takes effect. One slot is voted on at a time: a proposal names a slot and a requester, controllers cast approving votes, and the allocation commits once a quorum approves. Any controller may crash silently and stop voting until it recovers. The operations are: ProposeAlloc (when no vote is in progress, a new proposal is opened to allocate a slot that is not already allocated to some requester, resetting the vote tally), CastVote (a non-crashed controller that has not yet voted casts an approving vote for the current proposal), CommitAlloc (once a quorum of controllers has approved and the slot is still unallocated, the allocation is recorded and voting ends), CancelAlloc (an in-progress vote is abandoned without allocating), Crash (a not-yet-crashed controller crashes silently), and Recover (a crashed controller restarts). SAFETY PROPERTY: no access slot is ever allocated to two different requesters, so the same slot is never double-allocated.

  /\ config \in {"A", "B"}
  /\ pending \subseteq [ep: 1..MaxEpoch, cfg: {"A", "B"}]

  /\ config = "A"
  /\ pending = {}

                  [] p = "wash"  -> "exit"

  /\ config = "B"
  /\ items["entry"] > 0
  /\ items' = [items EXCEPT !["entry"] = @ - 1, !["exit"] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, config, pending>>

Announce(e, c) ==

  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![d] = "trying"]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = lock]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, slow>>

CASAcquire(d) ==
  /\ d \notin slow
  /\ state[d] = "trying"
  /\ snap[d] = "free"
  /\ lock = snap[d]
  /\ lock' = d
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![d] = "critical"]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<slow>>

CASFail(d) ==
  /\ state[d] = "trying"
  /\ (snap[d] # "free" \/ lock # snap[d])
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = "free"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, slow>>

Exit(d) ==
  /\ state[d] = "critical"
  /\ lock' = "free"
  /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, slow>>

BecomeSlow(d) ==
  /\ d \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, state, snap>>

Speedup(d) ==
  /\ d \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, state, snap>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones: Read(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones: CASAcquire(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones: CASFail(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones: Exit(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones: BecomeSlow(d)
  \/ \E d \in Drones: Speedup(d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

nl: A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares one critical resource (a single transmit channel) protected by a compare-and-swap lock register that holds either the current owner drone or the value free. To enter the critical section a drone first reads the lock register into a local snapshot, then attempts a compare-and-swap: the acquire succeeds only if its snapshot was free and the register is still free (unchanged since the read), in which case the register is atomically set to the drone; if the register changed in between, the attempt fails and the drone retries. On leaving, the owner sets the register back to free. A drone may be slow but never fails: while slow it neither reads nor attempts to acquire, but it always eventually speeds up, so no drone is permanently lost. The operations are: Read (a non-slow idle drone snapshots the lock register and moves to the trying state), CASAcquire (a non-slow trying drone whose snapshot was free and whose register is still free atomically takes the lock and enters the critical section), CASFail (a trying drone whose snapshot was not free or whose register no longer matches its snapshot gives up and returns to idle), Exit (the drone in the critical section releases the lock back to free and returns to idle), BecomeSlow (a drone becomes temporarily slow), and Speedup (a slow drone resumes). SAFETY PROPERTY: a drone is in the critical section only while the lock register names it as owner, so at most one drone ever occupies the critical transmit channel at a time.

EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Bags, Routers

VARIABLES record, snap, plan, reading, acked, overrideMode

vars == <<record, snap, plan, reading, acked, overrideMode>>
aBag == CHOOSE b \in Bags : TRUE
Ran(s) == {s[i] : i \in DOMAIN s}

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \in Seq(Bags)
  /\ snap \in [Routers -> Seq(Bags)]
  /\ plan \in [Routers -> Bags]
  /\ reading \subseteq Routers
  /\ acked \subseteq Bags
  /\ overrideMode \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ record = << >>
  /\ snap = [r \in Routers |-> << >>]
  /\ plan = [r \in Routers |-> aBag]
  /\ reading = {}
  /\ acked = {}
  /\ overrideMode = FALSE

Read(r, b) ==
  /\ r \notin reading
  /\ b \notin Ran(record)
  /\ reading' = reading \cup {r}
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = record]
  /\ plan' = [plan EXCEPT ![r] = b]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, acked, overrideMode>>

CommitAppend(r) ==
  /\ r \in reading
  /\ snap[r] = record
  /\ plan[r] \notin Ran(record)
  /\ record' = Append(snap[r], plan[r])
  /\ acked' = acked \cup {plan[r]}
  /\ reading' = reading \ {r}
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = << >>]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<plan, overrideMode>>

Retry(r) ==
  /\ r \in reading
  /\ snap[r] # record
  /\ reading' = reading \ {r}
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = << >>]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, plan, acked, overrideMode>>

EngageOverride ==
  /\ ~overrideMode
  /\ overrideMode' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, snap, plan, reading, acked>>

DisengageOverride ==
  /\ overrideMode
  /\ overrideMode' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, snap, plan, reading, acked>>

AdminForce(b) ==
  /\ overrideMode
  /\ b \notin Ran(record)
  /\ record' = Append(record, b)
  /\ acked' = acked \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, plan, reading, overrideMode>>

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Routers, b \in Bags: Read(r, b)
  \/ \E r \in Routers: CommitAppend(r)
  \/ \E r \in Routers: Retry(r)
  \/ EngageOverride
  \/ DisengageOverride
  \/ \E b \in Bags: AdminForce(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdates == acked \subseteq Ran(record)

nl: An airport baggage router maintains one shared routing log recording which bags have been routed, and updates it with optimistic locking with retry. To route a bag a router first reads a snapshot of the whole log and picks a not-yet-routed bag, then commits only if the log still equals the snapshot it read (optimistic check), in which case it appends its bag onto its snapshot and writes it back; if the log grew concurrently the snapshot is stale and the router must retry with a fresh read. A privileged administrator override lets the admin append a bag directly onto the current live log, bypassing the optimistic protocol, but the override can only be used while override mode is engaged. The operations are: Read (a router not already mid-update snapshots the whole log and selects a bag not yet in the log), CommitAppend (a mid-update router whose snapshot still equals the log, and whose bag is still unrouted, appends its bag onto its snapshot and installs it as the new log), Retry (a mid-update router whose snapshot no longer equals the log abandons its attempt to retry later), EngageOverride (the administrator engages override mode), DisengageOverride (the administrator disengages override mode), and AdminForce (while override mode is engaged, the administrator appends a not-yet-routed bag directly onto the current live log). SAFETY PROPERTY: every bag ever acknowledged as routed always still appears in the shared routing log, so no committed routing update is ever lost by a stale overwrite.
